overview: Istanbul straddles Europe and Asia with grand mosques, palaces and bazaars; Cappadocia has fairy-chimney valleys and sunrise hot-air balloons; add the coast at Antalya for beaches.
fit: Great for both; balloon rides usually have a minimum age (often 6+), so plan a viewing spot for the little one.
season: April–June and September–October are ideal (15–25°C). July–August is hot and crowded; winter is cold with snow in Cappadocia.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Istanbul (1-stop; Turkish Airlines via Delhi/Mumbai)

gettingAround: Istanbul trams and ferries with an Istanbulkart; tours or a driver in Cappadocia.

visa: Indian passport holders usually need a sticker visa from the Turkish visa centre. If you hold a valid US, UK, Schengen or Ireland visa or residence permit, you can get a Turkish e-visa online instead. Check current rules before booking.
